subject: Vendor onboarding: procurement checklist, DPA, SOC 2 & subprocessor list
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda@stratixlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratixlabs.com, legal@stratixlabs.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding docs needed to complete vendor setup

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. Procurement asked me to collect the following items so they can create a PO and close the GRC checklist:

- Executed DPA (or template we use)
- Latest SOC 2 report (or a link to the report)
- Current subprocessor inventory with hosting providers and data access scope
- Invoicing instructions and expected PO flow

Can you send those or point me to the right links/contacts? We need the SOC 2 link and subprocessor CSV by Friday to keep our Q3 procurement window.

Best,
Amanda Lee
Vendor Ops | Stratix Labs
Attachment: n/a

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda@stratixlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs needed to complete vendor setup

Amanda —

Appreciate the note. I’ve pulled together the packets you asked for and attached the primary files below. Quick summary so procurement has everything in one place:

1) DPA: "Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf" — standard DPA, exec-ready. If your legal wants redlines, send them to legal@redwood.ai and cc me; we usually turn around simple redlines within 3 business days.

2) SOC 2: public read-only report hosted here: https://redwood-status.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2-2025.html (attached a small text file with the canonical link). The report includes the auditor opinion and control matrix.

3) Subprocessors: "subprocessors_inventory_2026-07.csv" — includes provider name, region, purpose (hosting/monitoring/metrics), and data access level. Note: for customers requiring on-prem or VPC-only deployment we can exclude cloud-hosted subs.

4) PO / invoicing: see attached "PO_Instructions_Redwood.odt" — includes our vendor code, remit address, ACH details, and the email to route the PO to (payables@redwood.ai). Typical PO to go-live timeline is 7–10 business days after PO receipt. If you need a purchase order template filled, Ben (cc’d) can help.

I’ve copied Karthik from Security in case there are technical questions about the subprocessor scopes. Let me know if you want a short call to run through anything.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf (PDF), SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025_link.txt (text), subprocessors_inventory_2026-07.csv (CSV), PO_Instructions_Redwood.odt (ODT)

From: Legal - Stratix <legal@stratixlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda@stratixlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs needed to complete vendor setup

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 5:18 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Amanda —
> 
> Appreciate the note. I’ve pulled together the packets you asked for and attached the primary files below. Quick summary so procurement has everything in one place:
> 
> 1) DPA...

Thanks, Sofia — the materials look good overall. A couple of small clarifying questions from procurement/legal review:

- In the subprocessors CSV, column "Data Access Level" shows "Support" for a provider called "MetricHawk". Can you confirm whether MetricHawk has access to unredacted customer request payloads or only aggregated telemetry?
- For the DPA, Stratix legal requires a clause confirming 30-day notice prior to adding any new subprocessor that will have access to personal data. The DPA we saw says "commercially reasonable notice" — would Redwood agree to a 30-day explicit notice?

If you can confirm those two points (payload access scope for MetricHawk + 30-day notice), we can move forward with the PO. We’ve tentatively created PO draft HS-123456789 but will finalize once those are answered.

Regards,
R. Patel
Sr. Counsel, Stratix Labs
Attachment: n/a

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Legal - Stratix <legal@stratixlabs.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda@stratixlabs.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs needed to complete vendor setup

R. — Amanda —

Thanks for the review and the two clear asks. Quick answers:

- MetricHawk: they only receive aggregated telemetry and anonymized counters from our monitoring pipeline. They do NOT receive request payloads or any PII; I’ve flagged the CSV to change the wording from "Support" to "Aggregated Monitoring" to remove ambiguity. We can push an updated CSV to the shared Drive by EOD.

- DPA notice period: Redwood can accept a 30-day prior notice for new subprocessors that would have access to personal data. We’re comfortable committing to that clause; please confirm the exact language your counsel prefers and we’ll incorporate under expedited review.

Marissa (cc) will handle the PO routing and invoicing confirmation — Marissa, can you confirm expected net terms once the PO HS-123456789 is issued?

Sofia, happy to jump on a 15-minute call if Stratix legal wants a short walkthrough of the subprocessor inventory.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachment: updated_subprocessors_note.txt (will be uploaded)

From: Amanda Lee <amanda@stratixlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs needed to complete vendor setup

Thanks all — that addresses the questions. Procurement will update the PO draft HS-123456789 and route it to payables@redwood.ai. Net 30 is fine on our side; we'll include that in the PO.

Amanda Lee
Vendor Ops | Stratix Labs
Attachment: PO_HS-123456789_draft.pdf (PDF)
